questions.question: When is calculator tool mentioned?
questions.answer: Calculators and calculation tools are first mentioned when explaining that math should be handled by a calculator with 100% accuracy rather than an LLM, illustrating why AI needs tools [1]. In a multi-agent system setup, a calculator tool is specifically made accessible to a dedicated "Ask Calculator" or "Ask Math LLM" function to perform calculations [2]. Finally, it is mentioned in a prompt instructing a "Math Specialist" agent to use the calculate tool for every step and never compute math in its head [3].
